scope: CVG-004 bounded on-demand server-backed inventory purchase-entry report and audited export

criteria.description: The catalog, permissions, persisted purchase-header grain, strict status/search/date filters, deterministic order, exact twelve-field contract, 10,000-row bound and explicit operational/non-fiscal exclusions are implemented and covered.
criteria.limitations: The Vetus route establishes the existence of an EntradaNotaFiscal surface but not an authoritative dynamic-executor schema; this gate certifies only the frozen persisted-purchase operational reference contract.

criteria.description: The source is a bounded parameterized tenant-scoped query over persisted inventory_purchases, excludes blank invoice references, applies inclusive date/search/status filters and deterministic ordering, and the service defensively validates source rows and tenant context.
criteria.limitations: The proof is against disposable local PostgreSQL. Target RLS/roles, production scale and historical/fiscal document semantics remain outside this gate.

criteria.description: The API enforces billing.read plus inventory.read, derives the account from the authenticated principal, validates source/output shape and filters, rejects non-durable or unsupported sources and keeps execution, audit and export on durable ReportsService.
criteria.limitations: The local route proof does not authorize fiscal writes, external providers, scheduled delivery, credentials, target operations or release acceptance.

criteria.description: The Reports Workbench forwards strict filters, consumes and validates the authenticated server execution, renders the exact twelve purchase/receipt fields, exposes loading/error/empty behavior and does not reconstruct rows from local inventory, lots or consumptions.
criteria.limitations: Browser evidence is local and disposable; it does not certify deployed browser policy, accessibility acceptance or production assets.

criteria.description: Disposable PostgreSQL and authenticated browser proofs confirm account isolation, inclusive date/search behavior, stored-reference filtering, deterministic order, exact rows, durable execution/export/audit, blank-reference exclusion and no local inventory fallback.
criteria.limitations: The proof uses disposable local PostgreSQL/Redis/Chromium and does not certify target RLS/roles, backup/restore, RTO/RPO, continuous workers or production operations.

criteria.description: Intentional RED/GREEN, focused and full regressions, builds, typecheck, coverage, static/security checks, formatting, diff and empty-index hygiene satisfy the bounded repository quality bar.
criteria.limitations: Coverage and validators are local; remote CI, target operations, external homologation, production and release acceptance remain open.

criteria.description: A fresh independent post-remediation read-only review was attempted but no verdict was obtained; the limitation is retained rather than represented as approval.
criteria.limitations: The reviewer role was rejected by account model policy and two compatible default-review attempts timed out before verdict. A fresh independent post-remediation review is required before higher-confidence evidence or scope expansion.

criteria.description: The bounded result is reconciled without promoting CVG-004, general Vetus parity, clinical parity, enterprise readiness, target operations or release acceptance.
criteria.limitations: General Vetus parity, clinical parity, enterprise readiness, target operations, provider/fiscal homologation and release acceptance remain open; global promotion remains blocked.

gaps: No independent post-remediation reviewer verdict was available; the limitation is explicit and not treated as approval.
The Vetus dynamic executor does not provide an authoritative local schema for exact columns, filters or semantics.
Disposable local services do not certify target RLS/roles, backup/restore, RTO/RPO, Redis operations, remote CI, accessibility, operational LGPD, providers, production or release acceptance.
Fiscal NF issuance/cancellation, tax/CFOP, municipality/provider calls, credentials, supplier master and commercial reconciliation remain outside the operational purchase-reference contract.
conditions: Keep the result limited to authenticated tenant-scoped on-demand reads/exports of persisted inventory_purchases headers with non-empty stored invoice references and the exact twelve-field contract.
Obtain a fresh independent post-remediation review before treating this slice as higher-confidence evidence or expanding it.

Revalidate before adding fiscal interpretation, issuance/cancellation, tax/CFOP, lots/items reconstruction, valuation, schedules, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, backfill or release action.

Exclude fiscal document semantics, writes, tax/CFOP, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, backfill and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before adding fiscal semantics, a new source/grain, lot or item reconstruction, scheduled delivery, provider, credential, target, production, deployment, backfill or release activity.

next_action: Keep CVG-004 and the global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL with promotion BLOCKED; obtain an independent post-remediation review before higher-confidence use or scope expansion, and choose any next gap only through fresh scouting and a new implementation-ready authority.
